Specification: This module specifies a simple sequence-filtering computation over a single variable `myseq`. It defines a recursive helper inside `Select` that scans a sequence from the head and returns the suffix beginning at the first element satisfying a supplied test predicate; if no element satisfies the predicate, it returns the empty sequence. The behavior initializes `myseq` to `<< 1, 2, 3 >>` and then updates it in one step to the result of applying `Select` with a locally defined evenness test, so the next state keeps only the suffix starting from the first even element.
